scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npx concurrently "npm run test --prefix backend" "npm run test --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npx concurrently "npm run lint --prefix backend" "npm run lint --prefix frontend"
